name: znetwork_host_send_player_color_assignments_packet
description: zNetwork::HostSendPlayerColorAssignmentsPacket assigns a color to a joining player when needed and broadcasts the player-key/color-index table from the host.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork DirectPlay/session source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b860 validates host and joining-player guards, allocation of a free color when the joining record has no positive color, packet size count*8+12, zero-fill of the malloc packet, packet type 1, local player key payload, player count, list-order pair writes, reliable send, and packet free.
The native zNetwork host assignment smoke verifies the host packet fields, list-order player/color pairs, allocated joining-player color side effect, missing-player no-op, and non-host no-op.
